# Third-party components

Every dependency of the engine is listed here with its license. Policy: permissive licenses only (MIT, BSD, zlib, Apache-2.0, BSL-1.0, public domain); LGPL only as a dynamically linked, user-replaceable library; no GPL/AGPL/SSPL; proprietary SDKs only as optional developer-supplied plugins outside this repository. See docs/plan/08-toolchain.md section 8.8 and ADR-0014.

| Component | Version | License | Used by | How obtained | Declared as |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| doctest | v2.4.11 | MIT | tests only | CMake FetchContent at configure time | `doctest` |
| Tracy | v0.14.1 | BSD-3-Clause | core/profiling (only when ENGINE_TRACY is on) | CMake FetchContent at configure time | `tracy` |
| Vulkan-Headers | vulkan-sdk-1.4.357.0 | Apache-2.0 OR MIT | domain/gfx | CMake FetchContent at configure time | `vulkan_headers` |
| volk | vulkan-sdk-1.4.357.0 | MIT | domain/gfx (Vulkan meta-loader) | CMake FetchContent at configure time | `volk` |
| Vulkan Memory Allocator | v3.4.0 | MIT | domain/gfx | CMake FetchContent at configure time | `vma` |
| Slang | v2026.17.1 | Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception | shader compiler (build time only; prebuilt binaries) | CMake FetchContent of the release archive at configure time | `slang` |
| meshoptimizer | v1.2 | MIT | domain/geometry (meshlets, bounds, cluster LOD); domain/atlas (the proxy the content build's `--atlas repack` charts on) | CMake FetchContent at configure time | `meshoptimizer` |

| stb_image_write | v1.16 (same commit) | MIT OR Unlicense (public domain) | tests only (foundation/image's baseline JPEG fixture) | Comes with the stb checkout above; included only by foundation/image/tests/decode_tests.cpp | none of its own: the stb row's checkout |

The checkout's other sources (the v2/v3 and SIMD headers, the examples, `deps/ZFP`, `deps/nanozlib`) are not compiled | `tinyexr` |

| miniaudio | 0.11.25 (tag; commit 9634bedb5b5a2ca38c1ee7108a9358a4e233f14d, 2026-03-04) | Unlicense (public domain) OR MIT-0, the licensee's choice (the `LICENSE` file at that commit); the WAV, FLAC and MP3 decoders inside `miniaudio.h` are the same author's dr_libs under the same terms | domain/audio (playback devices through WASAPI, PulseAudio and ALSA; WAV, FLAC and MP3 decoding; decode-time sample-rate conversion; capability `ENGINE_WITH_AUDIO`) | CMake FetchContent at configure time (`cmake/EngineAudio.cmake`), only when the capability is on; `miniaudio.c` compiled as C into `engine_miniaudio` with DirectSound, WinMM, JACK, miniaudio's own null device, the encoders, the generators, the high-level engine, the node graph and the resource manager compiled out, linked privately, and its header included by one file, `domain/audio/src/backend.cpp`. The checkout's `extras/` (stb_vorbis, the libvorbis and libopus wrappers) is not compiled | `miniaudio` |
| Jolt Physics | v5.6.0 | MIT (the `LICENSE` file at that tag, Jorrit Rouwe) | domain/physics (rigid bodies, the character, collision queries; capability `ENGINE_WITH_PHYSICS`), in double precision | CMake FetchContent of the repository at configure time (`cmake/EnginePhysics.cmake`), only when the capability is on; the `Jolt` library target from its `Build/` project, static, with its unit tests, samples, viewer and performance test not built. Unrecorded here from its adoption until 2026-10-07, when the licence check's first run found it (T20) | `jolt` |

## Consulted, not vendored

Nothing below is fetched, linked, or compiled into anything; each is recorded because a published
work was read closely enough while writing our own implementation that the debt should be visible.

| Work | License | What was taken | Where it is used |
|---|---|---|---|
| NVIDIA FLIP (github.com/NVlabs/flip) | BSD-3-Clause | The numeric constants of the LDR-FLIP evaluator, checked against the reference: the contrast-sensitivity Gaussians per opponent channel, the color-difference exponent and its redistribution, the feature-detection width and exponent, and the D65 primaries. No source code. | `foundation/image/src/metrics.cpp`, written from the paper (Andersson et al., *FLIP: A Difference Evaluator for Alternating Images*, HPG 2020) — see `docs/subsystems/image.md` |
